## Quarto

```{r}
#| label: tbl-group-summary1
#| tbl-cap: "Grouped Summary Ex1"
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
pacman::p_load(tinytable, dplyr)
df <- iris %>%  group_by(Species) %>%  summarise(    N = n(),    AvgSepal = round(mean(Sepal.Length), 2),
    AvgPetal = round(mean(Petal.Length), 2),    .groups = "drop"  )

tt(df) %>%  style_tt(align = "c") %>%  theme_typst()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-group-summary2
#| tbl-cap: "Grouped Summary Ex2"
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
pacman::p_load(tinytable, dplyr)
df <- mtcars %>%  tibble::rownames_to_column("Car") %>%  arrange(gear, mpg)

grp <- df %>%  group_by(gear) %>%  summarise(    N = n(),    AvgMPG = round(mean(mpg), 2),    AvgWT = round(mean(wt), 2),
    .groups = "drop"  ) %>%  mutate(    label = paste0(      "Gear ", gear,      " | Cars: ", N,      " | Avg MPG: ", AvgMPG,
      " | Avg WT: ", AvgWT    ),    position = lag(cumsum(N), default = 0)  )

group_labels <- as.list(  setNames(grp$position, grp$label))

tt(  df %>% select(Car, gear, mpg, wt),  width = c(3, 1, 1, 1)) %>%  group_tt(i = group_labels) %>%  style_tt(i = 0, background = "#006D77",           color = "white", bold = TRUE) %>%  style_tt(i = "groupi", background = "#D9EAF7",         color = "#003B46", bold = TRUE) %>%  theme_typst()
```


## Colored Table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-group-summary3
#| tbl-cap: "Grouped Summary Ex3"
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
pacman::p_load(tinytable, dplyr)

df <- tibble(
  Campus = c("AUHR", "AURJ", "AUMP", "AUMH", "AUCG"),
  Support = c(3.17, 3.15, 3.19, 2.93, 2.99),
  Career = c(3.04, 2.98, 3.01, 2.75, 2.87),
  Infra = c(3.07, 2.99, 3.15, 2.64, 2.87)
)

tab <- tt(df) %>%  style_tt(i = 0, background = "#006D77",           color = "white", bold = TRUE)

for (j in 2:4) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    value <- df[[j]][i]
    bg <- case_when(
      value < 2.8 ~ "#F4CCCC",
      value < 3.0 ~ "#FFF2CC",
      TRUE ~ "#D9EAD3"
    )
    tab <- tab %>%   style_tt(i = i, j = j, background = bg)
  }
}

tab %>% theme_typst()

```

## Deviations in Table


```{r}
#| label: tbl-group-summary4
#| tbl-cap: "Table Deviations"
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
pacman::p_load(tinytable, dplyr)
df %>%  mutate(    GroupAvg = mean(Support),    Difference = round(Support - GroupAvg, 2),
    Rank = min_rank(desc(Support))  ) %>%  arrange(Rank) %>%
  tt() %>%  theme_typst()
```


## Table Containing Miniature charts


```{r}
#| label: tbl-mini-charts
#| tbl-cap: "Table with Miniature Charts"
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig.width: 8
#| tbl.height: 8
pacman::p_load(tinytable, dplyr)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tinytable)

admissions <- tibble(
  Campus = c("AUHR", "AURJ", "AUMP", "AUMH", "AUCG"),
  Y2022 = c(900, 700, 650, 850, 400),
  Y2023 = c(1050, 820, 740, 1050, 470),
  Y2024 = c(1200, 900, 850, 1200, 550),
  Y2025 = c(1350, 1020, 930, 1290, 670),
  Y2026 = c(1450, 1100, 980, 1250, 750)
)

sparkline <- function(x) {
  bars <- c("▁", "▂", "▃", "▄", "▅", "▆", "▇", "█")
  r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (diff(r) == 0) return(paste(rep("▄", length(x)), collapse = ""))

  index <- floor((x - r[1]) / diff(r) * 7) + 1
  paste(bars[index], collapse = "")
}

df <- admissions %>%  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(    Trend = sparkline(c_across(Y2022:Y2026)),
    Growth = 100 * (Y2026 / Y2025 - 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%  transmute(    Campus,    `Admissions 2026` = Y2026,
    `Growth %` = round(Growth, 1),    `Trend 2022–26` = Trend  )

tt(  df,  width = c(1.5, 1, 1, 2),  caption = "Campus-wise Admissions Performance and Trends") %>%  style_tt(i = 0, background = "#006D77",           color = "white", bold = TRUE) %>%  style_tt(j = 4, color = "#0077B6") %>%  style_tt(align = "c", fontsize = 1.5  ) %>%  theme_typst()
```

```{=typst}
#table(
  columns: (100pt, 80pt, 100pt),

  inset: 5pt,
  [Campus], [Support], [Career],
  [AUHR], [3.17], [3.04],
  [AURJ], [3.15], [2.98],
)
```

## Filled Graphs2


```{r}
#| label: tbl-filled-graphs2
#| tbl-cap: "Filled Graphs2"
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| message: false
pacman::p_load(tinytable, dplyr)
feedback <- tibble(
  Campus = c("AUHR", "AURJ", "AUMP", "AUMH", "AUCG"),
  Support = c(3.17, 3.15, 3.19, 2.93, 2.99),
  Career = c(3.04, 2.98, 3.01, 2.75, 2.87)
)

mini_bar <- function(x, max_value = 4, n = 15) {
  filled <- round(pmax(0, pmin(x / max_value, 1)) * n)

  paste0(
    strrep("█", filled),
    strrep("░", n - filled)
  )
}

df <- feedback %>%
  mutate(
    SupportBar = mini_bar(Support),
    CareerBar = mini_bar(Career)
  ) %>%
  select(Campus, Support, SupportBar, Career, CareerBar)

tt(  df,  width = c(1, 1, 3, 1, 3),
  caption = "Student Feedback: Campus Performance") %>%  style_tt(i = 0, background = "#006D77",  color = "white", bold = TRUE) %>%  style_tt(j = c(3, 5), color = "#0077B6") %>%
  style_tt(align = "c") %>%  theme_typst()
```
